t: Born into the shi class of Lu and raised in poverty, Confucius began teaching after he turned 30 and accepted students whatever their background.
As an official of Lu he tried to restore the duke's authority by having the three great families raze their walled strongholds, failed at the last of them and left the state in 497 BCE.
His teaching that government should rest on virtue and ritual rather than law and punishment became the official philosophy of imperial China under Emperor Wu of Han.
dyk: Confucius asked no tuition of a prospective student, only a symbolic gift of a bundle of dried meat. The name Confucius itself was coined in the late 16th century by early Jesuit missionaries to China, as a Latinized form of Kongfuzi.
ev: Kong Qiu is thought to have been born at Zou, in the state of Lu
Yang Hu, a retainer of the Ji family, rebels and seizes power in Lu
After Yang Hu is expelled, Confucius is appointed governor of a town, later rising to Minister of Crime
Hou Fan's revolt at Hou opens the way for Confucius to press the three families to dismantle their strongholds
The walls of Hou and Bi are razed, but Duke Ding's siege of Cheng fails
Confucius leaves Lu and begins years of travel among the states of north-east and central China
He dies in Lu at the age of 71 or 72 and is buried north of Qufu

f.born: Thought to have been born on 28 September 551 BCE in Zou (in modern Qufu, Shandong), in the state of Lu; son of Kong He, commandant of the local Lu garrison, of the shi class
f.died: c. 479 BCE in Lu, of natural causes, at the age of 71 or 72; buried on the bank of the Sishui River, north of Qufu
f.role: Teacher from after the age of 30; governor of a town in Lu (from 501 BCE), then Minister of Crime; left Lu in 497 BCE; adviser to officials of Lu after his return at 68
f.known: The teachings called Confucianism; the Analects, compiled by his followers; the Silver Rule; filial piety and rule by virtue rather than punishment; teaching students of every class; the Five Classics, by traditional attribution
